answer: Make every identity lock a copper deposit that only unlocks when a randomly chosen peer re-runs its claimed work and confirms the result - an opal shard of proof, unique per task. A prism of auditors splits each agent's output history into public facets, so clones submitting identical work light up as one facet and lose every deposit at once. A sybil farmer must fund a real deposit and real work per clone, while one honest agent posts a single deposit and keeps working.
